The '''Black Sun warehouse''' was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] used by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Rianna Saren]] infiltrated the warehouse while on her [[Mission to Coruscant (Rianna Saren)|mission]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and stole an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] shipment there. This building was guarded by various [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. There were also many traps like [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and electrical barriers.<ref name="LA" />
